{{Top|canon=Second}}
{{Quote|Words mean nothing. Now seconds count.|[[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]]|<ref name="Empire 9">[[Empire 9|''Empire'' 9]]</ref>}}
A '''standard second''' or '''second''' is a small measurement of [[Time/Legends|time]]. Sixty standard seconds comprised a [[Standard minute/Legends|standard minute]].

==Behind the scenes==
''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]'' page 199 erroneously states that there are 60 seconds in a [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hour]].
